mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies with a temperature of 75 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park and the moon is currently in its third quarter phase.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is offering free 30-minute rides on their tri-shaw bikes along the Military Ridge State Trail, and the Recreation Department is currently hiring for adult fitness instructors.
There is plenty to do with the downtown farmer's market and live music at Paddy Mac's today, plus catch the Concerts in the Park series happening tomorrow at Century School Park.
In our weekly police report, on July 31st, an officer performed a traffic stop that resulted in the driver being arrested for O W I and cited for suspended vehicle registration.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by and enjoy a delicious frozen treat.
